notes.title: Winter Sale!
notes.notes:
🌬❄️ The icy winds of winter bring a special promotion! ❄️🌬

We’re excited to announce that Hannah is part of the Winter Sale! Enjoy a 20% discount and dive into this immersive adventure. But hurry, the promotion runs until January 2nd!

We’d like to thank everyone who has supported the game so far. Your feedback is always received with great care and helps us keep improving ❤️

If you haven’t had the chance to play yet, this is the perfect opportunity. Don’t miss it!

🎮 See you next time, and have fun!

notes.title: Update 1.0.10
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello community! 🎮[/h2]

We want to share with you the improvements, adjustments and design decisions we have implemented and are working on for Hannah. We appreciate your reports and suggestions, let's continue building a better experience together!

🛠 [b]Corrected[/b] (Fixed)
[list]
[*]  Boss fight at the end of Chapter 1.
[*]  Changes and improvements in the End of Chapter 3-1.
[*]  Changes and improvements in Chapter 3-2.
[*]  Item recovery is now clearer.
[*]  Improvements when recovering an item.
[*]  You can skip the credits scene.
[*]  Improvements to the Hospital Puzzle.
[*]  Solution to general collision problems.
[*]  General performance and quality of life improvements.
[/list]
